title: Existence of a compatible map on a common open
statement: Let $X$ be Noetherian, $J$ ideal sheaf data, $H$ coherent, $N$ a coherent formal module [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], and $\delta:N\to H^\wedge$. Let $(U_i)$ be arbitrary opens. Supply coherent $H_i=H|_{U_i}$ and $F_i$, maps $a_i:F_i\to H_i$ with actual kernel and cokernel annihilated by a positive power of $J|_{U_i}$, and $\beta_i:N|_{U_i}\cong F_i^\wedge$. Supply over-site modules $L_i$, isomorphisms $l_i:L_i\cong F_i$, maps $b_i:L_i\to H|_{U_i}$ and $q_{i,n}:L_i\to N_n|_{U_i}$ whose transfers are $l_i a_i$ and $l_i\pi_{F_i,n}\beta_{i,n}^{-1}$, and assume $q_{i,n}\delta_n=b_i\pi_{H,n}$. For any $i,j$ and open $W\subseteq U_i\cap U_j$, there exists a morphism $f:L_i|_W\to L_j|_W$ whose components on every $V\subseteq W$ satisfy $f_V b_{j,V}=b_{i,V}$ and $f_V q_{j,n,V}=q_{i,n,V}$ for every $n$. No invertibility, uniqueness or cocycle assertion is part of this conclusion.

proof.text: Apply coherentCompletion_over_normalization to H on W. Apply torsionLocalModel_restriction separately to the i and j local models, with the resulting coherent over-site restriction of H as their common target.

Whisker delta to the common over-site and compose with the normalized completion comparison c. For either restricted local model, transport hdelta through overMap; use naturality of overFunctorMap and then map through overEquiv. The supplied b and q equations and normalization of c show, after cancelling l and the quotient epimorphism, that beta followed by the completed a equals this common map. Thus theta=betaF inverse followed by betaG commutes with the completed arrows to H.
Apply torsionControlled_completion_hom_lift_exists on the Noetherian open W to theta and the two actual restricted annihilation bounds.

Use the fully faithful overEquiv to take the preimage of lF followed by the lifted g followed by lG inverse. Faithfulness, g followed by aG equals aF, and the supplied b equations give b compatibility. Evaluate the completed equation of g at n, precompose with the quotient projection and use cokernel.π_desc to give q compatibility. Evaluate these over-site morphism equalities on each V contained in W; the component comparisons are identities, giving the exact two families of equations.

theorem torsion_common_open_comparison_map
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (J : X.IdealSheafData)
    (H : CoherentModules X) (N : CoherentFormalModule X J)
    (δ : N ⟶ (completion X J).obj H)
    (ι : Type u) (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (Hlocal : ∀ i, CoherentModules (U i).toScheme)
    (hHlocal : ∀ i, (Hlocal i).obj = (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι).obj H.obj)
    (Fi : ∀ i, CoherentModules (U i).toScheme)
    (ai : ∀ i, Fi i ⟶ Hlocal i)
    (βi : ∀ i, N.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι ≅
      formalCompletionSystem (J.comap (U i).ι) (Fi i).obj)
    (hbound : ∀ i, ∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct
        (Scheme.idealSheafPower (J.comap (U i).ι).toModulesι s).2 (kernel (ai i).hom)) ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct
        (Scheme.idealSheafPower (J.comap (U i).ι).toModulesι s).2 (cokernel (ai i).hom)))
    (Li : ∀ i, SheafOfModules ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over (U i)))
    (li : ∀ i, (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).functor.obj (Li i) ≅ (Fi i).obj)
    (bi : ∀ i, Li i ⟶ H.obj.over (U i))
    (qi : ∀ (i : ι) (n : ℕᵒᵖ), Li i ⟶ (N.obj.obj n).over (U i))
    (hbi : (∀ i, (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).functor.map (bi i) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv (U i)).hom.app H.obj ≫
          eqToHom (hHlocal i).symm = (li i).hom ≫ (ai i).hom))
    (hqi : (∀ (i : ι) (n : ℕᵒᵖ), (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).functor.map (qi i n) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv (U i)).hom.app (N.obj.obj n) =
          (li i).hom ≫ formalModuleQuotientπ (J.comap (U i).ι) (n.unop + 1) (Fi i).obj ≫
            (βi i).inv.app n))
    (hδ : (∀ (i : ι) (n : ℕᵒᵖ), qi i n ≫ (δ.hom.app n).over (U i) =
        bi i ≫ (formalModuleQuotientπ J (n.unop + 1) H.obj).over (U i)))
    (i j : ι) (W : X.Opens) (hi : W ≤ U i) (hj : W ≤ U j) :
    ∃ f : (SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (homOfLE hi : W ⟶ U i)).obj (Li i) ⟶
      (SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (homOfLE hj : W ⟶ U j)).obj (Li j),
      (∀ (V : X.Opens) (hV : V ≤ W),
        f.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV))) ≫
          (bi j).val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (hV.trans hj)))) =
            (bi i).val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (hV.trans hi))))) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕᵒᵖ) (V : X.Opens) (hV : V ≤ W),
        f.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV))) ≫
          (qi j n).val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (hV.trans hj)))) =
            (qi i n).val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (hV.trans hi)))))
